_doc: Patches applied on top of build/SFK_clean.swf by tools/patch.py. Paths are relative to mods/. Data tables in mods/data/ are picked up automatically.

pcode.why: MochiBot beacon: return null instead of POSTing to the dead core.mochibot.com
Load button: only load a used, selected slot (fixes TypeError #1009/#1010 numRegions on empty slots) and drop the GamerSafe.instance.showLogin() null call
v2.1: the stage KEY_DOWN handler called battlefield.method_54 twice per key press; drop the redundant second call so F advances one speed step
v2.1 battle speed: F cycles stage.frameRate 30/60/90 while a battle is running
v2.1 battle speed: reset to 30 fps whenever no battle is running; keep the enemy deployment Timer (class_154.var_419, 100 ms) scaled to 3000/frameRate
v2.1 battle speed: Iron Will regen counter advances frameRate/30 per 30 ms tick so regen per battle-second is speed-independent
v2.1: New Campaign opens the Select a Map screen (var_35) instead of jumping to Western Europe's kingdom list
v2.1: Back on the kingdom list returns to Select a Map
v2.1: draw generated map thumbnails (class_113.syncPreview) and hide the dead overworldlabs link on the kingdom list
v2.1: rebuild the Kingdoms list when a faction is eliminated by an AI, so the dead kingdom disappears and stats stay aligned
